svg.aria-label: Seven candidate renderings for diagram nodes, with a recommendation
svg.text: Seven candidate renderings for a diagram node
The same fragment on every row — the nine shapes of ADR 0003, two of them containers — so the comparison bears on the rendering and nothing else.
Every node carries two names: the product, which the lockup can write, and the instance, which the lockup alone will never write. Each row's verdict is my opinion, not a decision.
Product and instance are both written here — but
our six views write only the product today.
The boundary has neither symbol nor identity:
box() knows only eight shapes out of nine.
From 12 % to 20 % of the box for the symbol.
More ink, not one variable more — and two lines
of text to fit under a taller symbol.
The cylinder caps at 36 px: it loses 14 px under
its ellipse. An unfavourable cost/gain ratio.
Applies step 6 of our own recipe, never once
applied to the six existing views.
Touches neither the grammar nor the geometry.
Free, and combines with any other row.
The lockup writes the product, the instance goes
But its size follows the width of the box:
pill is 1.01:1 on “external”: look at S3.
Same content as D, but the fill encodes the shape:
zone light, node grey, application white.
The nesting reads without following the borders.
instance as title, product as subtitle
Inverts the hierarchy: the instance becomes the
title, the product drops to subtitle.
The only rendering that truly answers “name the
fills of E, hierarchy of F, accent of C
The fill encodes the shape, the instance is the
title, the product the subtitle, one subject only
is accented. The symbol keeps its pill: it alone
carries the brand colour, and logos get recognised.
Survives greyscale, and needs no ADR.
Recommendation: G, which combines the three compatible levers — and C alone if nothing is to be touched. B should be ruled out, D is not enough on its own, F cannot be decided without an ADR.
None of this is applied: only row A matches the state of the repository. Sheet generated by scripts/specimen-candidates.mjs.
